en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 10. `Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Muhammad ib `Imran al-Daqqaq (RA) said: Muhammad ibn Ya`qub, on the authority of `Ali ibn Muhammad, on the authority of Sahl ibn Ziyad, on the authority of Muhammad ibn al-Walid whose title is Shabab al-Sayrafi, on the authority of Dawud ibn alQasim al-Jafri that I asked Abu Ja`far al-Baqir (AS): “May I be your ransom! What is the meaning of the Needless [al-Samad]?”
He (AS) answered: “He is the Master on whom all depend in major and minor.”
